annotations.annotation_text: Viconian marker "thunder" on page 5 ("The Fall of Finnegan"): Giambattista Vico's cyclical philosophy — divine, heroic, and human ages followed by thundering ricorso — structures this passage within the mythic fall of Tim Finnegan / HCE, the thunderclap awakening primitive religion, and the recumbent giant embedded in the Dublin landscape. The current Age of Gods (Theocratic) phase shapes the language, institutional imagery, and historical echoes of the dream.
sources: Beckett, Samuel. Dante... Bruno. Vico.. Joyce. https://archive.org/details/ourexagminationr0000unse
Ricorso.net: Viconian Structure in FW. https://www.ricorso.net

annotations.annotation_text: Oneiric dimension "night" on page 5 ("The Fall of Finnegan"): the nocturnal consciousness surfaces within the mythic fall of Tim Finnegan / HCE, the thunderclap awakening primitive religion, and the recumbent giant embedded in the Dublin landscape. During this Age of Gods (Theocratic) phase, Joyce reconstructs the sleeping body's sensory deprivation — dimmed sight, distorted hearing, dream-logic association — transforming somatic experience into polyphonic language.
sources: Bishop, John. Joyce's Book of the Dark. https://archive.org/details/joycesbookofdark0000bish
Freud, Sigmund. The Interpretation of Dreams. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/4349
Troy, Mark L. Mummeries of Resurrection. http://www.rosenlake.net
